Our students steadily progress as scholars, athletes, and teammates from middle school through high school, each graduating with lacrosse techniques, life skills, and an actionable plan for pursuing a college degree or entering the workforce.

Our staff is satisfied by their work, appreciated for their efforts, and able to become more effective in their roles – whether that’s coaching students, coaching coaches, or coaching communities. Everyone on the team owns their role as a vital contributor to our sustainable business model.
Schools are enriched by our added support, our communities are energized with more play, and our network grows with college and career-ready Harlem Lacrosse alumni.
Ultimately, there are fewer barriers to fields, classrooms, and board rooms, and each space is strengthened with greater diversity.

items.text: WE ARE COACHES AND CONNECTORS WHO USE LACROSSE TO GUIDE ACADEMIC PROGRESS AND PREPARE STUDENTS FOR LIFE AFTER HIGH SCHOOL.

We locate in cities where lacrosse is emerging and additional educational support is needed. We form mutually beneficial partnerships with schools and community leaders to empower the diverse youth we coach. We play the long game, nurturing authentic relationships with students and families from sixth grade through high school graduation. Strengthened by our engaged, well-resourced community of alumni, families, counselors, teachers, partners, and funders, we integrate athletics and academics to support students as they define and pursue a pathway toward college or career. Ultimately, we use our spaces, relationships, and skills to expand educational access and opportunity and foster diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in lacrosse.

Systemic inequities harm our youth. Girls and children who are Black, Brown, Indigenous, and LGBTQ+ are disproportionately impacted by unjust laws, policies, and cultural biases that force them to jump needless hurdles throughout childhood.

Lacrosse builds power. Individually, lacrosse develops physical, emotional, and relational strength. Globally, lacrosse brings together people, resources, and passion. We believe this sport can be harnessed for equitable youth empowerment.

Students deserve agency. Our students are playing the game of life. They leverage their skills, energy, and networks to score their personal goals. Our role is not to run the field for them, but to coach them toward victory.

Progress takes time. On-time graduation is possible. Vibrant diversification of our sport is possible. D1 status is possible. Working with our students day after day, year after year through responsive programming equips them to turn their ambitions into realities.

Diversity enriches lacrosse. The future of lacrosse depends on inclusion. Teams around the nation and world become stronger when they recruit athletes with identities that have been historically overlooked and systemically excluded.
Families — Parents, guardians, and relatives of our students who seek a safe, consistent, effective opportunity for their children to practice positive habits
Executive Board — Professionals and HL alum who provide their skills and networks to secure resources, offer sound governance, and ensure financial sustainability

Advisory Board — Local education and non-profit leaders, lacrosse athletes, and HL alum who hope to support our programming by raising awareness about city-specific programs and securing funding opportunities aligned with city goals
Students — Youth in grades 6-12 who hope to play lacrosse, find belonging, develop agency, reach goals, and have fun
Alumni — Former Harlem Lacrosse participants who hope to advance our mission

School & Community Partners — School administrators and youth-facing leaders who hope to provide students with an effective, immediate place to practice positive emotional, social, and academic habits Volunteers who invest their time and talent to positively impact HL students

Funders — Corporations, foundations, and individuals who hope that their investment in our organization will consistently yield positive outcomes for students and support a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive lacrosse community
Staff — Team players who believe in the power of our sport to expand equitable opportunity
Staff — Advocates who believe in the power of our students to diversify and enrich the lacrosse community at large
Staff — Program Directors (PDs) — Lacrosse and academic coaches who hope to support our athletes through transformative programming
Staff — Managing Directors (MDs) — Team managers who hope to sustain positive impact by supporting our coaches through responsive, inclusive professional development
Staff — Executive Directors (EDs) — Team leaders who hope to use their management, entrepreneurial, and advocacy experience to deepen our impact

Staff — Executive Leadership Team (ELT) — Harlem Lacrosse champions who hope to use their relational intelligence, executive leadership, and passion for students to cultivate our healthy, sustainable, and impactful work environment and network
